description: Phase 5 explicit syntax-conditioned generation. Locked N_EXEMPLARS=0, same 50 ASINs × 169 (user, asin) pairs. 4 conditions: control (no syntax constraint), random (5 random F3 features), target (top-5 deviating F3 features from μ_u in cohort reverse-mapped to F3), anti_target (target features with sign flipped). Tests causal chain: explicit syntax control → controllable PCA48 location.
rationale: target ≈ anti_target (causal effect +0.000). LLM 无法被 NL instructions 推到具体 PCA48 location.

next_step_hint.GO: Phase 5.B — increase TOP_K_CONSTRAINTS to {8, 12}, test if more constraints = better. Then scale to 2174 ASIN cohort.
next_step_hint.PARTIAL_GO: Phase 5.B — try more diverse F3 features or longer constraint descriptions.
next_step_hint.NO_GO: Phase 6 — explore alternative generation paths (e.g. constrained decoding, syntax-aware finetuning, or per-user syntax templates).
next_step_hint.STRONG_NO_GO: Stop optimizing generation. The bottleneck is the syntax representation's disconnect from controllable generation. Document the gap as a finding.
